name: submit_feedback
description:
Send a bug report, friction note, or feature request to the Vercel team when the user wants to give Vercel feedback. message describes what happened and what would have helped; optional context holds structured details such as the task, expected behavior, actual result, and impact. Each submission also includes the MCP server version, the OAuth client ID, and the user, team, and project IDs when available. Retrying after an uncertain outcome can create a duplicate. Do not include secrets or personally identifiable information.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel feedback {message}. Fill placeholders from inputs. Use only when the error response includes cliFallback.

context.description: Optional relevant details, such as the affected tool and expected behavior. Include only information the user intends to share.

message.description: The feedback the user wants to send to Vercel.
